crossProjectFindings: Same 88 URLs in the 23 and 24 indexes. Do not treat HTTP 200 or a longer extract as a new product capability. io.net, several dashboards, LuckyPool, bntpool.com/start, and the Nosana API docs are shells or title-only pages.

2Miners help pages share one template: regional hosts, share difficulty does not change rewards, optional BTC or TON payout with small stated fees. Coin, algorithm, port, and native-payout fee still differ; do not copy ETC, RVN, KAS, ERG, ZEC, ZEPH, or ETHW rules across rows. API doc lists both PPLNS and SOLO pools but is not a minimum-payout table.
Hiveon general FAQ is a valid analogy for what a share means. It is not a source for these coins' fees or minima.

Compute marketplaces, Akash, io.net, Vast, Golem, Nosana, Gonka, FlyAI, and Acurast, publish hire price, credits, GLM, points, or benchmark epochs. Those are not mining revenue. Golem's fetched guide excludes macOS.
Solo CKPool is the clearest income-model risk: a block lottery to the miner's address plus a 2% fee, not daily pool pay. Parano1d pool is proportional per found block and is not the chain homepage.

PRL Kryptex and LuckyPool are separate. The miner README's no fee is the software fee. CSD payout rules were on the pool site; the Compute Substrate org site is a different surface. MDS requires MSS pool addresses and uses gMDS units. BNT in these sources is Seine's Blocknet, with Apple Silicon marked experimental, not an older coin of the same ticker.

XID mainnet dates and the macOS 14+ build line are in the fetched MMM text; a current-OS compatibility pass is still a gap. IOTA in these sources is Macrocosmos Train at Home, not IOTA layer 1, and score thresholds are documented as changeable.
No search volumes, rankings, or AI-citation counts were available in the source files, so none are reported.
reviewStatus: Main reviewed critical scope distinctions; factual claims still require per-pack acceptance, not automatic product copy.

mainCorrections.issue: Source analyst's blanket mustNotClaim P2PK as mining destination conflates protocol coinbase reward-locking P2S script with the user's pool payout address. Our tool accepts supported P2PK payout addresses; do not describe those as direct solo coinbase script destinations. Verify pool help and address documentation in context.
Competitor keyword lists are inferred content intents, not measured search queries, search volumes, rankings or actual AI citations.
Same88URLs does not mean identical page content. source-diff.json records actual changes; HTTP200 and JSshell are not factual verification.
